projects.title: GUI-based FTP client for KolibriOS
projects.short_description: The aim is to build a GUI-based FTP client in x86 assembly/FASM. Currently KolibriOS only has a CLI-based FTP client with basic functionality. People...
projects.description:
The aim is to build a GUI-based FTP client in x86 assembly/FASM. Currently KolibriOS only has a CLI-based FTP client with basic functionality. People who are not familiar with a command line interface might find it difficult to operate the client.

The client will support functions in the existing FTP client as well as other functions like searching for files within remote directory, resuming/aborting downloads, logging and GUI-specific features like displaying directory hierarchy, upload/download progress bar using boxlib GUI library.

projects.description: I would like to work on TLS/SSL library for KolibriOS. I am going to write basic version of mbed TLS (used to be PolarSSL). Library will be written in pure FASM. I am going to implement in library a some base key exchange algorithms(Diffie-Hellman, RSA and maybe more), some types of hash-functions ( SHA256 - main task,SHA1, MD5), AES encryption algorithm, and random number generator.

projects.title: SDL2 Port for KolibriOS
projects.short_description: SDL is a free cross-platform multimedia library that implements an interface to graphics, sound and input devices. This library is actively used when...
projects.description:
SDL is a free cross-platform multimedia library that implements an interface to graphics, sound and input devices. This library is actively used when writing cross-platform graphical applications (mostly games). The previous version of the library, SDL 1.2, is already ported for KolibriOS, but there is no SDL 2 port, which is the most up-to-date and supported version.

Having support for SDL 2 in KolibriOS will not only allow developers to develop new applications using the updated functionality of the library, but also to port a huge number of existing open source programs (mostly emulators and games) from other platforms, because SDL 2 is often used to implement frontend/graphics in such applications. This will also allow to completely deprecate the current SDL 1.2 library as we can use a compatibility layer for applications relying on SDL 1.x.

projects.title: NVMe SSD Driver Proposal
projects.short_description: NVM Express (NVMe), also referred to as Non-Volatile Memory Host Controller Interface Specification (NVMHCIS), is an open specification documenting...
projects.description:
NVM Express (NVMe), also referred to as Non-Volatile Memory Host Controller Interface Specification (NVMHCIS), is an open specification documenting how to access and control the computer's non-volatile storage media.

Currently, NVMe drives have limited support in KolibriOS, and with their increasing popularity in newer computers, it is important that a driver conforming to the latest specifications is implemented.

The project deliverables are to implement basic NVMe SSD driver written in FASM conforming to the NVMe base specification 1.4 and add namespace support.

projects.short_description: This project aims to bring modern, decentralized communication to KolibriOS through the development of a native Matrix messaging client. Since the...
projects.description: This project aims to bring modern, decentralized communication to KolibriOS through the development of a native Matrix messaging client. Since the Matrix API requires HTTPS for secure data exchange—a capability not currently supported in the OS—the first phase involves porting Mbed TLS 4.0.0 and integrating it directly into the networking stack. This foundational work enables secure authentication and real-time syncing for the Matrix client while providing a reusable TLS 1.2/1.3 framework for other KolibriOS applications. The final result will be a fully functional client and a robust encryption library that upgrades the security standards of the entire operating system.

projects.title: RSS news reader

projects.description: The Goal: A 100% x86 Assembly (FASM) news reader that replaces bloated web browsing with high-performance, native headlines. The Strategy: Use FEED struct array allocation (with a +5 buffer) for O(1) efficiency and a Unified Schema Engine to parse RSS. Core Deliverables: a state-driven, 2-pane GUI with "Read/Unread" tracking, a modular backend for http.obj networking and asmXml parsing, and a headless test harness.

projects.title: ExtX File System Improvement

projects.description: This project improves the file system driver of KolibriOS, specifically for extX file systems. Currently, the driver only supports 1 INCOMPAT feature fully implemented for R/W, and 2 for R. And can only guarantee reading and writing to ext2 filesystems. My primary goal is to achieve read/write support for modern ext4 file systems by implementing the remaining key INCOMPAT then RO_COMPAT features, and write support for the two currently implemented INCOMPAT features that are missing it. If time permits later, I might start in the simple action of recovery in case the file system was not safely unmounted, providing a simple foundation for future contributors (or me) to fully complete this huge and useful feature.
